instruction: I need to make the title of my document more prominent. Please change the font size of the first paragraph ("Presentation Instruction") to 18 points to make it stand out as the document title.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font size of the first paragraph (index 0, 'Presentation Instruction') to 18 points. The evaluator extracts font sizes from all paragraphs and verifies that paragraph 0 has font size 18pt. Verified that the document has paragraph 0 as the title that needs to be resized.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts font sizes from docx paragraphs using python-docx library and properly converts EMU to points

Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction (font size of first paragraph)
Proper postconfig: activates window and saves document (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted to disk before getter reads file
